newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian cuts off cheating boyfriend's penis.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian cuts off cheating boyfriend's penis.

text.p: A 17-year-old Brazilian girl cut off her boyfriend's penis with a kitchen knife during a lover's tiff at a hotel on Tuesday, a police spokesman said.

He said Joyce Tracy Gomes Savitch mutilated her 27-year-old boyfriend, Joao Carlos Mato Favia, because he cheated on her. The couple had spent the night at a hotel on the outskirts of Vitoria in Espirito Santo state when the argument broke out on Tuesday morning.
Favia was flown to a hospital in Sao Paulo two hours after the incident and is said to have a good chance of having his penis reattached, according to private television Globo news.
